generation.scope: A distinct opposite matrix on a finite Frobenius window has nonzero determinant if the point scheme has at least fourteen support points. At thirteen a singular matrix requires twelve reduced points and one length-eight point of embedding dimension three. On any curvilinear configuration it requires all lengths even and the half-length subscheme on a determinantal cubic curve. Thus triple octics are necessary far beyond reduced configurations.

open_mathematics: Resolve the remaining singular opposite matrices, in particular even curvilinear configurations on determinantal cubic curves and nonplanar length-eight configurations, and separate rank-drop curve cases for nonsingular presentations.
